title: Public Alert No. 07/2026- Alert on Surveillance and mop up of Counterfeit Dostinex (0.5mg) Tablets Found in Circulation

products.manufacturer: Pfizer Italia S.R.L, Ascoli Piceno, Italy.

summary: NAFDAC warns of falsified and parallel-imported Dostinex 0.5mg tablets circulating in Nigeria. Pfizer Nigeria Ltd confirms the genuine product, though registered, has not yet been imported. Three batches affected; no NAFDAC reg. number. Mop-up ordered nationwide.
